subject: words
title: Sight words 2
about: Twenty-four more Dolch and Fry high-frequency words, this time the ones with a part that does not follow his class's code (come, want, pretty, four, little). Each tricky part is marked in pink, the way CKLA underlines tricky words; these are the irregularly spelled words NC RF.1.4.g expects him to read by the end of the year.
tip: Say the regular parts normally, then point to the pink part and tell him what it says; after a few tries he should read the whole word at a glance.
